name: library-html
description: Library management template — catalogue search with real availability, loans with per-profile terms, renewal blocked by the hold queue, fines worked out on the spot with the arithmetic shown, and holds that promote the next reader automatically. Free, MIT, no backend.

paragraphs: A public library with both of its sides, built with plain HTML, vanilla JavaScript and Tailwind CSS v4: the catalogue where readers search and reserve, and the desk where the librarian lends, takes returns and settles fines. Availability is never a stored flag — it is the count of copies not currently on loan, so a return changes the catalogue on the spot. Loan terms come from the reader's profile, renewal is refused while someone is waiting in the hold queue, the fine is worked out at the moment you look at it with its arithmetic shown line by line, and a returned copy promotes the next…
